info.title: Atlas Enterprise Reference API
info.description: Runnable backend foundation with independent service databases. Public paths are Gateway prefixes. Authentication uses verified OIDC access tokens; tenant_id, roles, rep_id and client_id claims are authoritative. Mutation commands require Idempotency-Key; transitions require expectedVersion. Money is in integer minor units. Existing local-demo UI workflows are not represented as fully migrated API features. In-app notifications and payment records do not imply external email, SMS or payment-provider execution.
